title: Trip.com Reviews

startUrls.title: Trip.com hotel URLs
startUrls.description: Trip.com hotel pages, e.g. ["https://www.trip.com/hotels/lisbon-hotel-detail-2561632/valverde-hotel/"]; any trip.com country subdomain (us., uk., …) works. The numeric id sits after hotel-detail- in the URL, so no page is read; a URL without it is read once for its hotelId. Hotel names are not accepted: find the hotel on trip.com and pass its URL or id. Give at least one of startUrls or hotelIds.
startUrls.sectionCaption: Which hotels (URL or id, at least one)
startUrls.sectionDescription: Trip.com hotel URLs and/or Trip.com's numeric hotel ids. A URL and the id of the same hotel are read once. Hotel names are not accepted.

hotelIds.title: Trip.com hotel ids
hotelIds.description: Trip.com's numeric hotel ids, e.g. ["2561632"] — the number after hotel-detail- in any hotel URL, and the hotel_id on an earlier run's rows. Use to re-read the same hotels every day. An id Trip.com does not know is reported in a status row as an error and costs nothing.

maxReviewsPerHotel.title: Max reviews per hotel
maxReviewsPerHotel.description: The main cost control: reviews delivered per hotel, e.g. 50; default 200 (up to $0.80 per hotel at $0.004 a review). 0 = every review the hotel has (at most 20,000 per hotel per run; large hotels run to thousands, so 0 can cost $10+). Reviews come in reviewsSort order: 50 with "most_recent" = the 50 newest. languages applies BEFORE this cap (filtered by Trip.com); maxRating and requireText AFTER it — pair maxRating with reviewsSort "lowest_rated".
maxReviewsPerHotel.sectionCaption: How many reviews, in what order, which languages

reviewsSort.title: Order
reviewsSort.description: "most_recent" (default), "highest_rated", "lowest_rated" or "most_relevant" — Trip.com's own orders. Use "lowest_rated" with maxReviewsPerHotel 50 for "the 50 worst reviews" or with maxRating for complaints; "most_recent" for a scheduled feed (each run re-reads the newest N — dedupe on review_id).

languages.title: Review languages
languages.description: Review languages to keep, by name, e.g. ["English"] or ["English", "Chinese"]; empty (default) = every language. Known names: English, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, German, French, Spanish, Russian, Thai, Turkish, any name the free hotel row lists for that hotel, or a Trip.com language id. Filtered by Trip.com before fetching, so skipped reviews cost nothing. Trip.com carries many Chinese reviews from Ctrip (携程): this is how to keep or drop them. An unknown name ends the run, nothing charged.

maxRating.title: Only reviews at or below this score
maxRating.description: Only reviews at or below this score on Trip.com's 0-10 scale, e.g. 6 for complaints; 0 (default) = every score. Use for "negative reviews", "complaints", "what guests dislike". Reviews above the score are never delivered or charged, but they count against maxReviewsPerHotel: set reviewsSort "lowest_rated" so the cap is spent on low scores.
maxRating.sectionDescription: Reviews these remove are never delivered or charged. Both are applied after maxReviewsPerHotel, so pair maxRating with reviewsSort "lowest_rated"; languages is applied by Trip.com itself, before the cap.

requireText.title: Only reviews with a written comment
requireText.description: true = deliver and pay only for reviews with written text (Trip.com reviews almost always have some; this guards the rest). Default false. Applied after maxReviewsPerHotel.

includeHotelRow.title: Include a hotel row
includeHotelRow.description: true (default) = also one free row per hotel (type "hotel"): name, stars, address, city, country (from one extra request to the hotel page), overall rating and rating word, the four sub-scores, review_count, and the languages and travel types its reviews come in, with counts. Never charged. For "hotel ratings without the reviews" keep this true and set maxReviewsPerHotel 1 (one review, $0.004).

locale.title: Site locale
locale.description: Trip.com locale for labels, e.g. "en-US" (default), "en-GB", "ja-JP", "ko-KR", "zh-HK", "de-DE". Sets the language of rating words and travel types only; review text is delivered as written, never translated, with language on every row. Not a filter: use languages to choose review languages.

sessions.title: Parallel sessions
sessions.description: Parallel proxy sessions (egress IPs), 1 to 16, default 4. More is faster; each is paced separately by perIp. Leave the default unless runs are throttled.
sessions.sectionDescription: Leave these alone unless a run is being throttled.

perIp.title: Requests per second per IP
perIp.description: Requests per second per session, 0.1 to 3, default 1 (Trip.com tolerated bursts of 20 from one IP in testing). Lower it only if a run is throttled.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy, default {"useApifyProxy": true}; the default datacenter group works for Trip.com. A refused call answers 200 with no review block — the actor detects that shape and retries on a fresh IP, so a throttled hotel is never reported as having no reviews. No browser, no login, no client-side token.

description: Trip.com (Ctrip) hotel reviews. Minimal input: {"startUrls": ["https://www.trip.com/hotels/lisbon-hotel-detail-2561632/valverde-hotel/"]} or {"hotelIds": ["2561632"]} — one of the two; hotel names are not accepted. maxReviewsPerHotel defaults to 200 (up to $0.80 per hotel at $0.004 a review): set it lower for a scheduled feed, 0 for every review.
